notes:
A fresh new look for Edit & sign, plus a Blur tool to hide private details.
New: Screenshot & edit (Ctrl+Alt+S), and an optional glass look on Windows 11 (Settings > General).

Safer passwords: FilesBolt now warns you if a password has appeared in a known data breach.
Fixed choosing a new password with "Forgot password".
Security improvements.
Small improvements.
New: right-click a photo to resize it for email (under 500 KB).
New: Resize pictures. Edit & sign can now copy, paste and crop. Settings fix.
Fixes Settings not opening for some people.
Safer file conversions and a new Download my data option in Settings.
Small fixes and improvements.
Small fixes and improvements.
Small fixes and improvements.

FilesBolt now speaks Spanish, French, German and Hindi: Settings > General > Language.
Other small fixes.

FilesBolt now speaks Spanish: Settings > General > Language.
Other small fixes.

PDF to Word now works even without Microsoft Word.
Edit & sign: Select can now pick up part of the page itself, to move, resize or erase it.
Compress makes many PDFs much smaller.
Updates download more reliably.

Merging now always saves, even with an unusual file name.
PDF to Word tells you right away if your Microsoft Word is too old.
Other small fixes.

Show password: click the eye in any password box.
Signing in with a deleted account now tells you so.
Extra protection when deleting an account with two-step sign-in on.

Edit & sign: remove any single item with its red x, right-click to Delete / Duplicate / Bring to front / Rotate,
bigger handles, More colours, neater B/I/U, eyedropper fixes.

Cleaner tooltips with shortcut keys. Invite codes fill in automatically when you sign up from a friend's link.
Edit & sign thumbnails turn with the page. More reliable updates.

FilesBolt is free during our launch. Animated sidebar icons. Edit & sign: brush, double arrow, notes, Paint-style Select, rotate pages, fixes.
Choose which emails you get. Take a screenshot in Contact support.

Edit & sign opens big PDFs in about a second and shows text sharp at any zoom.
Fix: if an older copy of FilesBolt was on the PC, shortcuts now always open the newest version.
